newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CARACAS SHARES CLOSE DOWN IN SLUGGISH MARKET.
newsitem.headline: CARACAS SHARES CLOSE DOWN IN SLUGGISH MARKET.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange closed mostly lower in slow trade as investors waited for labor disputes to be resolved, brokers said.
According to preliminary figures from the exchange, the market's 19-share .IBC index fell 1.71 percent to 9,344.05, as 26 stocks fell, 13 rose and six closed flat.
Brokers said the market was still unnerved by an on-going dispute between union and business leaders over wage rises.
"The market was rather erratic and very slow, even liquid stocks fell," said Profimerca broker Miguel Gonzalez.
